authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Platts p. 148 equates barkhā with barshā; p. 147 derives barshā rain from feminine Sanskrit varṣā. The exact existing parent is therefore CDIAL 11396 varṣā, not generic varṣa 11392. This selection follows the explicit lexical cross-reference; learned or regional transmission remains open. Exact survey form borsa is preserved.
